name: Reborn in 2000: Crush on My Deskmate
original_name: 重生2000：从追求青涩校花同桌开始
overview: Terminally ill Chen Fan is reborn in 2000 and reunited with his first love, Su Ruochu, who died in a past-life accident. With a second chance at life, he vows to build a business empire from the ground up and give her the love and future they never had.
